remarks: Looking for a spacious home in the Deerhurst Park area? Then this 5-bedroom 2.5 bath in the Courtland Worth area is waiting for you! Former owners lived and loved it for over 45 years & hated to leave the area & their home. The expansive first floor has abundant natural light and hardwood floors throughout and under the carpet in the living areas. The extra-large living room comes with a wood burning fireplace for the ambiance or money saving-back up heat source, wonderful built-in cabinets, & plenty of room for entertaining. The beautiful kitchen is complete with appliances, large popular Corian countertops, recessed lighting & plenty of cupboards and drawers. If a first-floor Primary bed is a must, this one has huge closets as well as plenty of room for a king size bedroom set and desk. (Upper primary bedroom has a huge walk-in closet! ) You get to choose your primary bedroom. The other two 1st floor bedrooms are equally spacious; one is also set up for 1st floor laundry if you so desire. This beauty can live as a ranch style home for anyone, w/extra living space for a growing family or multi-generational if needed. Upstairs was added in 1997 and has 2 full size bedrooms, a second full bath, as well as an office. You will enjoy the room! Wait, you also will enjoy the lower finished basement level-family room complete with: wood burning fireplace, new luxury vinyl flooring, a wet bar for your party, knotty pine walls, a workshop, glass block security windows, 1 half bath in the hall and more. Outside you will embrace the beauty of mature trees, perennial gardens, a fenced in yard, 2.5 car garage, concrete driveway, newer windows (some), & front covered porch. The neighborhood is close to a bus route, all shopping & amenities, 18 minutes to Buffalo medical corridor, and schools or Universities. Just add your cosmetic choices and enjoy the popular walkable neighborhood for many years to come!
